reviewNotes: Demetrius's complete three-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, preserving scientific terminology and the Night Market and clinic contexts.

winter_16.000.source: I highly recommend the submarine tour. There are some very fascinating creatures living in the deep ocean.
winter_16.000.translation: Recomand cu căldură turul cu submarinul. În adâncurile oceanului trăiesc niște creaturi foarte fascinante.

summer_25.000.source: The colder season is coming up so I'm here to get my flu vaccine.
summer_25.000.translation: Se apropie anotimpul rece, așa că am venit să-mi fac vaccinul antigripal.

summer_25.001.source: Doctor Harvey, have you read the latest 'Biology and Medicine'? There's an article I think you'd be interested in.
summer_25.001.translation: Doctore Harvey, ai citit cel mai recent număr din „Biologie și medicină”? Conține un articol care cred că te-ar interesa.
